---
title: "Product explorer"
subtitle: "Tariffs, prices and import sources for any HS10 product, 2017 to the latest month"
toc: false
---

Search for a product by name (for example *washing machines*, *toys*, *solar panels*) or by
HS code. Pick a line to see its additional tariff rate by supplier, its pre-duty unit value and
duty-inclusive price, and where its imports come from. Data are monthly U.S. Census imports for
consumption at the 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HS10) level; the tariff rates are the
statutory additional duties compiled for this project from the Federal Register. See
[the report](index.qmd) for methods and the legal status of the IEEPA duties.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
meta = d3.json("explorer_data/meta.json")
index = d3.json("explorer_data/index.json")

// Search words with plurals stemmed; mirrors tpt.report.explorer.words.
function words(text) {
  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/'/g, "").split(/[^a-z0-9]+/)
    .filter(w => w.length >= 2)
    .map(w => w.endsWith("sses") ? w.slice(0, -2)
      : w.endsWith("ies") && w.length > 4 ? w.slice(0, -3) + "y"
      : w.endsWith("s") && !w.endsWith("ss") && w.length > 3 ? w.slice(0, -1) : w);
}

STOP = new Set(["and", "or", "of", "the", "for", "with", "an", "in", "to"])

catalog = index.rows.map(([hs10, desc, imports]) => ({hs10, desc, imports, w: words(desc)}))

aliasList = Object.entries(index.aliases).sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length)

function search(query, limit = 60) {
  const q = query.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9.\s-]/g, " ").trim();
  if (!q) return [];
  const digits = q.replace(/[.\s]/g, "");
  const byImports = (a, b) => (b.imports ?? 0) - (a.imports ?? 0);
  if (/^\d{2,10}$/.test(digits)) {
    return catalog.filter(d => d.hs10.startsWith(digits)).sort(byImports).slice(0, limit);
  }
  let text = ` ${q} `;
  for (const [term, expansion] of aliasList) text = text.replace(` ${term} `, ` ${expansion} `);
  const toks = words(text).filter(t => !STOP.has(t));
  if (!toks.length) return [];
  return catalog
    .filter(d => toks.every(t => d.w.some(w => w.startsWith(t))))
    .map(d => ({...d, lead: d.w[0].startsWith(toks[0]) ? 1 : 0}))
    .sort((a, b) => b.lead - a.lead || byImports(a, b))
    .slice(0, limit);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof query = Inputs.text({
  label: "Product",
  placeholder: "washing machines, toys, 8450 \u2026",
  value: "washing machines",
  submit: false,
  width: 420
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
results = search(query)
viewof pick = {
  const view = results.length
    ? Inputs.table(results, {
        columns: ["hs10", "imports", "desc"],
        header: {hs10: "HS10", desc: "Description", imports: "Imports, 12 mo."},
        format: {
          hs10: fmtCode,
          desc: d => sentence(d),
          imports: d => d == null ? "\u2013" : usd(d) + "m"
        },
        width: {hs10: 104, imports: 110},
        layout: "fixed",
        multiple: false,
        required: false,
        value: results[0],
        rows: 8
      })
    : html`<p class="explorer-empty">No product matches &ldquo;${query}&rdquo;. Try a shorter or more
           general word, or an HS code.</p>`;
  view.id = "explorer-results";
  return view;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
product = {
  const row = pick ?? results[0];
  if (!row) return null;
  const rel = `${row.hs10.slice(0, 2)}/${row.hs10.slice(0, 4)}.json`;
  if (!fileCache.has(rel)) fileCache.set(rel, d3.json(`explorer_data/${rel}`));
  const p = (await fileCache.get(rel))[row.hs10];
  return {...p, hs10: row.hs10, desc: row.desc, imports: row.imports};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
productHeader = product ? html`<div id="explorer-product" class="explorer-product">
  <h3>${fmtCode(product.hs10)} &middot; ${sentence(product.desc)}</h3>
  <p>Quantity unit: ${unitName(product.u)}.
     ${product.mfn == null ? "" : `Normal (MFN) duty in the latest month: ${pct(product.mfn)}.`}
     Imports in the 12 months to ${monthName(meta.data_month)}:
     ${product.imports == null ? "none" : `${usd(product.imports)}m`}.
     Largest suppliers since 2017: ${sources.filter(s => s.c !== "other").map(s => s.name).join(", ")}.
     <a href="explorer_data/${product.hs10.slice(0, 2)}/${product.hs10.slice(0, 4)}.json">Data (JSON)</a></p>
</div>` : html``
```

### Additional tariff rate by supplier

Statutory additional duty in each month the supplier shipped the product (gaps are months
with no imports from it). It excludes the normal (MFN) duty and does not net out exclusions,
USMCA claims or in-transit exemptions; the duties Census records as collected are in the price
chart below.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div id="chart-tariff">${product ? Plot.plot({
  height: 300,
  width: Math.min(width, 860),
  style: {background: "transparent"},
  marginLeft: 48,
  x: {type: "utc", label: null},
  y: {label: "Additional duty (%)", tickFormat: d => d3.format(".0f")(d * 100), grid: true, zero: true},
  color: colorScale,
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: tokens.axis}),
    Plot.line(rates, {x: "date", y: "rate", z: "name", stroke: "name", strokeWidth: 2,
                      curve: "step-after"}),
    Plot.tip(rates, Plot.pointerX({x: "date", y: "rate", z: "name",
      title: d => `${d.name}\n${monthName(d.month)}\nAdditional duty: ${pct(d.rate)}`}))
  ]
}) : ""}</div>`
```

### Pre-duty unit value and duty-inclusive price

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof priceSource = Inputs.select(["All countries", ...sources.map(s => s.name)], {
  label: "Supplier"
})
```

Customs value per unit before duty, and the same plus duties Census records as calculated at
entry (MFN and additional duties). Unit values mix models and qualities within a code, so
month-to-month jumps can reflect a change in what was shipped rather than in prices.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div id="chart-price">${product && product.u !== "X" ? Plot.plot({
  height: 300,
  width: Math.min(width, 860),
  style: {background: "transparent"},
  marginLeft: 56,
  x: {type: "utc", label: null},
  y: {label: `$ per ${unitName(product.u)}`, grid: true, zero: true},
  color: {domain: ["Pre-duty unit value", "Duty-inclusive price"],
          range: [palette[0], palette[1]], legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: tokens.axis}),
    Plot.line(prices, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "measure", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.tip(prices, Plot.pointerX({x: "date", y: "value", z: "measure",
      title: d => `${d.measure}\n${monthName(d.month)}\n${usd(d.value, ",.4~r")} per ${unitName(product.u)}`}))
  ]
}) : html`<p>No quantity is recorded for this code, so there is no unit value.</p>`}</div>`
```

### Import sources

Share of the product's import value by supplier, by quarter.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div id="chart-sources">${product ? Plot.plot({
  height: 300,
  width: Math.min(width, 860),
  style: {background: "transparent"},
  marginLeft: 48,
  x: {type: "utc", label: null},
  y: {label: "Share of imports (%)", tickFormat: d => d3.format(".0f")(d * 100), domain: [0, 1]},
  color: colorScale,
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(shares, Plot.stackY({x: "date", y: "share", fill: "name", order: sourceNames,
                                     stroke: tokens.surface, strokeWidth: 1, curve: "step-after"})),
    Plot.tip(shares, Plot.pointerX(Plot.stackY({x: "date", y: "share", z: "name", order: sourceNames,
      title: d => `${d.name}\n${d.quarter}\n${pct(d.share)} of ${usd(d.total / 1e3)}m`})))
  ]
}) : ""}</div>`
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## About these data
HS10 codes are revised most Januaries, so a product can start or stop part way through the
window (the report's border estimates link codes across revisions; this page does not). Charts show the five largest suppliers of the
product since 2017; the rest are grouped as "Other". Duties recorded by Census are as assessed
at entry and are not revised for the refunds that followed the Supreme Court's IEEPA ruling.
Shipments below the de minimis threshold were mostly not recorded before its end. The data
behind each product are linked above as JSON; the bundle is built by `make explorer`
(`src/tpt/report/explorer.py`).
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
fileCache = new Map()

dark = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const check = () => notify(document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark"));
  check();
  const obs = new MutationObserver(check);
  obs.observe(document.body, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"]});
  return () => obs.disconnect();
})

// Validated palette (src/tpt/viz/theme.py): fixed slot order, separate dark steps.
THEME = ({
  light: {surface: "#fcfcfb", axis: "#c3c2b7", muted: "#898781",
          series: ["#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#008300"]},
  dark: {surface: "#1a1a19", axis: "#383835", muted: "#898781",
         series: ["#3987e5", "#d95926", "#199e70", "#c98500", "#d55181", "#008300"]}
})
tokens = dark ? THEME.dark : THEME.light
palette = tokens.series

CHINA = "5700"

// China always takes the first slot so it keeps one colour across products.
sources = {
  if (!product) return [];
  const rest = product.s.filter(s => s.c !== CHINA && s.c !== "other");
  const china = product.s.filter(s => s.c === CHINA);
  const other = product.s.filter(s => s.c === "other");
  return [...china, ...rest, ...other].map((s, i) => ({
    ...s,
    name: s.c === "other" ? "Other" : (meta.countries[s.c] ?? s.c),
    color: s.c === "other" ? tokens.muted : palette[china.length ? i : i + 1]
  }));
}
sourceNames = sources.map(s => s.name)
colorScale = ({domain: sourceNames, range: sources.map(s => s.color), legend: true})

month = i => meta.months[i]
toDate = m => new Date(`${m}-01T00:00:00Z`)

// Expand a change-point list [[i, value], ...] to n monthly values.
steps = (cp, n) => {
  const out = new Array(n);
  let k = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    while (k + 1 < cp.length && cp[k + 1][0] <= i) k++;
    out[i] = cp.length ? cp[k][1] : null;
  }
  return out;
}

// Each source on the full month axis: v ($k), uv (null = none), e, r (null without imports).
decoded = sources.map(s => {
  const N = meta.months.length, n = s.v.length, e = steps(s.e, n), r = steps(s.r, n);
  const out = {...s, V: new Array(N).fill(0), UV: new Array(N).fill(null),
               E: new Array(N).fill(null), R: new Array(N).fill(null)};
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const j = s.m0 + i;
    out.V[j] = s.v[i];
    if (s.v[i] > 0) { out.UV[j] = s.uv[i] > 0 ? s.uv[i] : null; out.E[j] = e[i]; out.R[j] = r[i]; }
  }
  return out;
})

span = {
  const traded = meta.months.map((_, j) => decoded.some(s => s.V[j] > 0));
  return [traded.indexOf(true), traded.lastIndexOf(true)];
}

rates = decoded.filter(s => s.c !== "other").flatMap(s =>
  d3.range(span[0], span[1] + 1).map(j =>
    ({name: s.name, month: month(j), date: toDate(month(j)), rate: s.R[j]})))

prices = {
  if (!product) return [];
  const chosen = priceSource === "All countries" ? decoded : decoded.filter(s => s.name === priceSource);
  const out = [];
  for (let j = span[0]; j <= span[1]; j++) {
    let vq = 0, q = 0, v = 0, d = 0;
    for (const s of chosen) {
      const val = s.V[j], uv = s.UV[j], e = s.E[j];
      if (uv > 0) { vq += val; q += val / uv; }
      if (e != null) { v += val; d += val * e; }
    }
    if (q <= 0) continue;
    const m = month(j), uv = vq / q, e = v > 0 ? d / v : 0;
    out.push({measure: "Pre-duty unit value", month: m, date: toDate(m), value: uv});
    out.push({measure: "Duty-inclusive price", month: m, date: toDate(m), value: uv * (1 + e)});
  }
  return out;
}

shares = {
  if (!product) return [];
  const byQ = new Map();
  for (const s of decoded) s.V.forEach((v, j) => {
    if (j < span[0] || j > span[1]) return;
    const m = month(j), y = m.slice(0, 4), qn = Math.floor((+m.slice(5) - 1) / 3);
    const key = `${y} Q${qn + 1}`;
    if (!byQ.has(key)) byQ.set(key, {quarter: key, date: new Date(Date.UTC(+y, qn * 3, 1)), by: new Map()});
    const e = byQ.get(key).by;
    e.set(s.name, (e.get(s.name) ?? 0) + (v ?? 0));
  });
  return [...byQ.values()].flatMap(({quarter, date, by}) => {
    const total = d3.sum(by.values());
    return total > 0 ? sourceNames.map(name => ({quarter, date, name, total,
                                                 share: (by.get(name) ?? 0) / total})) : [];
  });
}

UNITS = ({NO: "unit", KG: "kg", DOZ: "dozen", PRS: "pair", DPR: "dozen pairs", M2: "m\u00b2",
          M3: "m\u00b3", L: "litre", T: "tonne", M: "metre", GM: "gram", DOZPRS: "dozen pairs",
          DOZPCS: "dozen pieces", PCS: "piece", DS: "dose", BBL: "barrel", X: "no unit",
          KM3: "1,000 m\u00b3", CYK: "clean yield kg", PFL: "proof litre", LNM: "linear metre",
          CTN: "content tonne", SQ: "square", GR: "gross", THS: "thousand units", MWH: "MWh",
          FBM: "board foot", JWL: "jewel", CG: "centigram", KTS: "kg total sugars"})
unitName = u => UNITS[u] ?? u
fmtCode = c => `${c.slice(0, 4)}.${c.slice(4, 6)}.${c.slice(6)}`
sentence = s => s.charAt(0) + s.slice(1).toLowerCase()
usd = (x, f = ",.3~r") => "$" + d3.format(f)(x)
pct = r => `${d3.format(".1f")(r * 100)}%`
monthName = m => new Date(`${m}-01T00:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString("en-US",
  {month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"})
```
